_comment: Read by scripts/public-data-audit.mjs. On the Sanity free plan a dataset is
PUBLIC: anyone can read every published document over a plain URL, with no
token, and the project id ships in the page source. This file records what we
have deliberately decided is fine to publish, and why.
Every entry needs a reason. The point is that the judgement gets made once,
in daylight, rather than by whoever is looking at a red build at 9pm.
blockedTypes: never public, whatever fields they carry. Use for anything
holding member or family data - the audit fails if even one is readable.
allowedTypes: a type that trips the personal-data heuristics but is genuinely
publishable, listing the exact fields that are allowed.

staff.reason: Staff contact addresses are published on the public About page on purpose.

siteSettings.reason: The organisation's own postal address and phone, printed in the site footer.

legalPage.reason: Privacy and terms pages carry a contact address by law.
